result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Corio may terminate on 30 days’ written notice without an early-termination charge, receives a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and Commerce One has no convenience-termination right during a committed term. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” exceeds what the playbook requires and introduces uncertainty about the scope and financial consequences of partial termination. Otherwise, the existing term and for-cause termination provisions are preserved and the drafting is professional.
